title: Evaluation of the layered embedding
statement: Let $C$ be a Boolean circuit tree on $n$ variables, and let $x$ assign a Boolean value to each variable. The value computed by the unique output of its layered feedforward embedding on input $x$ equals the value obtained by evaluating $C$ directly on $x$.
hypotheses_covered: $C$ is a Boolean circuit tree on $n$ variables
$x$ is an assignment of Boolean values to the variables
replaced:
Let $C$ be a Boolean circuit on $n$ variables, and let $x : \mathrm{Fin}\,n \to \bbf_2$
be an assignment of Boolean values to those variables. Form the feedforward embedding of
$C$, a layered feedforward circuit with a single output wire, and let its unique output
value under $x$ be the Boolean it computes. Then this value equals $C(x)$, the value
obtained by evaluating the circuit $C$ directly on the assignment $x$.
